subject: Graduate Civil Engineer, Newcastle, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I'm applying for the Graduate and Undergraduate Civil Engineers role in your Newcastle office, advertised on SEEK (job 94936643). Your undergrad and development program page asks for a resume and cover letter at this address, so I'm sending both for the Newcastle graduate path.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design covering road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge and field engineer, coordinating crews, inspections, materials and progress reports.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for site and regional work and open to discussing a move to Newcastle. I have no Australian consulting design experience yet, so mentoring on live Hunter projects is what I am looking for.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Drawings: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

letter.subject: Application for Graduate and Undergraduate Civil Engineers, Newcastle
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Graduate and Undergraduate Civil Engineers role in your Newcastle office, advertised on SEEK (job 94936643). The role describes mentoring on land development, roads, stormwater and infrastructure projects across Newcastle, the Hunter and NSW, with real project involvement from the start, and that matches where I want to begin in Australian consulting.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language: road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage design and documentation in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, applying Australian Standards and Austroads guides, with Before You Dig Australia enquiries, cost estimates, bills of quantities and risk registers. In 2019 I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines.

My site experience is from April 2019 to February 2020 in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewed drawings, and carried out inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials and prepared site, material and progress reports.

I have no Australian consulting design experience yet. I am based in Melton, Victoria, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for site and regional work and open to discussing relocation to Newcastle.
My resume is attached and my drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I would be glad to talk about the Newcastle team and how a graduate contributes on your Hunter projects.

screening_answers.question: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
screening_answers.answer: I have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa (no sponsorship required for the visa period).

screening_answers.question: How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
screening_answers.answer: I am available to start; I am not in a role that requires employment notice.

checklist: Decide whether you would relocate to Newcastle before applying.
Send the prepared email to info@makereng.com.au with both PDFs, or apply on SEEK job 94936643 with the same letter and resume.
Answer SEEK screening questions honestly (485 visa to December 2027; notice as above).
Submit while the advert is open (expires about 29 October 2026).
Press Applied on the tracker with the date and method (Email or SEEK).
notes: Direct Newcastle graduate or undergraduate civil role. Published program inbox info@makereng.com.au accepts resume and cover letter. SEEK apply also available. Relocation is Marc's call.
